name: B1040 - Web - Document Converters Control
description: Intent: Block-tier hard enforcement on Web clipboard paste and upload into the Unauthorized Document Converter surface at sensitivity floor [3,4] — shuts down sensitive document content being uploaded to non-sanctioned format-conversion services. Exclusions: excludes domains in Websites_Authorized_Document_Converter_Domains_[is]; ships disabled by default — enable only after corporate-approved converters are populated in the Authorized list and W1041 reviews are clean. Requirements: WIP — pending analyst testing.
